description: A SvelteKit notes app with the static adapter (SSG), obfuscated via @afterpack/sveltekit (over @afterpack/vite): client-side navigation between prerendered routes, a zod-validated form, module-level $state shared across routes, notes persisted to localStorage, and a report route with a universal load function that reads the notes through a class with private fields and getters. @afterpack runs on Vite closeBundle, so the client bundle is obfuscated before the static adapter copies it into build/.

build.note: vite build (via SvelteKit) obfuscates the client bundle on closeBundle; adapter-static copies it into build/. version.name pinned in svelte.config.js for determinism. AFTERPACK_E2E_DIST_DIR and AFTERPACK_E2E_KIT_DIR move the baseline build beside it.

interactions.description: The obfuscated client hydrates the prerendered page; the counter increments on click.
